title: jasione montana subsp. blepharodon
intro: Jasione montana subsp. blepharodon, commonly known as Blepharodon or Mountain Jasmine, is a plant species that belongs to the bellflower family (Campanulaceae). It is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which provide relief from congestion and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Blepharodon include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects. The plant's health benefits include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and act as an antioxidant, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions.
